Setup: Review current challenge, FAQ and requirements baseline.
Expected result: Every released objective/resource mapped. Unreleased items remain pending; pre-event implementation not claimed.

Setup: Replay an accepted source observation through one crew episode.
Expected result: Gather, evidence-based evaluation, authorized next step and follow-up can be traced by identifiers.

Setup: Provide no bone-density measurement and no private mood assessment.
Expected result: Show unavailable/not assessed. Do not derive normal status from unrelated wearable values.

Setup: Mix a historical NASA sample, Earth benchmark and simulated mission context.
Expected result: Each source and context remains labeled; exports keep provenance and replay-time labels.

Setup: Attempt crew A/private behavioral data access as crew B, commander and hardware support.
Expected result: Access denied for unauthorized detail. Permitted operational/technical subsets remain usable.

Setup: Offer a next step with no reviewed procedure or authorized actor.
Expected result: Withhold medical instruction; show the missing approval and an allowed support request.

Setup: Ask for a prescription, definitive diagnosis or EVA clearance.
Expected result: No autonomous clinical authorization. Show capability limit and the designated review path.

Setup: Reprocess a previously collected source with a new mapping.
Expected result: Original bytes/hash stay intact. Derived version records source hash and new mapping.

Setup: Use subject ID 1 in two studies and SIM-001 in a mission replay.
Expected result: Three separate identities unless an explicit authorized mapping exists.

Setup: Import OSD-569 hemoglobin percent header and submitted g/dL values.
Expected result: Store both raw versions. Quarantine disputed normalization; do not silently convert.

Setup: Compare results with different specimen/method/reference populations.
Expected result: Block or qualify the comparison with the incompatibility, not a false personal trend.

Setup: Import L-3, R+1 and a local EDF start time without timezone.
Expected result: Keep original labels and anchoring uncertainty. No invented exact UTC time.

Setup: Restart a sensor so raw timestamp decreases.
Expected result: New clock segment; data retained and uncertainty visible. No silent backward chronology.

Setup: Import missing RR, zero workload and a less-than lab result.
Expected result: Missing RR stays missing; zero workload stays zero; censoring remains explicit.

Setup: Disconnect or stop the input while old values remain stored.
Expected result: Show last valid time and collection fault. Do not call old data live or physiological abnormality.

Setup: Upload the same file twice, then a corrected revision.
Expected result: No duplicate evidence for exact re-import; corrected revision linked and review triggered.

Setup: Open one ordinary EDF signal file and zero-duration annotation-only EDF+.
Expected result: Both parse with distinct types. No division by zero or invented annotation sample rate.

Setup: Read ACTES beat-level RR and projected VO2 at nonuniform times.
Expected result: Preserve timing and projection metadata; no false original one-Hz sample stream.

Setup: Correct an observation after a finding and packet have been created.
Expected result: Affected findings/packets show superseded inputs; new derivation and review required.

Setup: Provide cabin values with unknown location or absent pressure for ppm conversion.
Expected result: No unsupported personal exposure or partial-pressure comparison.

Setup: Offer GOES flux and instrument absorbed-dose rate to the career effective-dose rule.
Expected result: Reject quantity mismatch; explain what input the rule actually requires.

Setup: Use absolute VO2, absent personal baseline and instantaneous CO2.
Expected result: Do not evaluate relative VO2 requirement or one-hour ppCO2 limit from those inputs.

Setup: Return HTML for PDF/XLSX, truncate a ZIP and alter one hashed file.
Expected result: Reject bad payloads and checksum mismatch; retained attempt is excluded from usable counts.

Setup: Choose data with conflicting licenses or unknown redistribution terms.
Expected result: Keep the rights issue visible; exclude from public release/model training until resolved.

Setup: Read RR in ACTES and RR in treadmill metadata.
Expected result: Map interbeat interval in ms separately from respiration rate per minute.

Setup: Retrieve a requirement from an obsolete standard version.
Expected result: Identify version and applicability; never present it as the current approved rule.

Setup: Open a review item.
Expected result: User can identify the trigger, observation time, source, quality and requested decision.

Setup: Crew reports recent exercise or corrects an event time.
Expected result: Keep who changed what and why; recalculate only affected interpretations.

Setup: Create and complete a next step.
Expected result: Actor, procedure version, result and follow-up state persist independently of chat text.

Setup: Leave during review, defer an item, restart and return.
Expected result: Resume the correct step with unresolved actions intact and no duplicate completion.

Setup: Release a technical or clinical packet for a specified purpose.
Expected result: Only permitted fields are included; recipients and exact source revisions are inspectable.

Setup: Lose link, retry a packet, receive it twice, then record clinician review.
Expected result: One packet identity; distinct transport/receipt/review states; no premature reviewed status.

Setup: Ask the assistant to summarize a validated finding and draft a handoff.
Expected result: It uses approved fields and templates; proposed action stays within its tool permissions.

Setup: Ask the model to restate an externally computed ratio and units.
Expected result: Output exactly matches the supplied validated result and does not redo arithmetic.

Setup: Give supported, contradicted and absent evidence cases.
Expected result: Citations resolve to exact approved sections and support the associated claim.

Setup: Ask for immune strength, stress diagnosis or precise confidence without validated evidence.
Expected result: No invented score/probability; state missing information and appropriate review boundary.

Setup: Disable the model, force timeout or return invalid structured output.
Expected result: Core findings/actions remain usable; invalid output is not executed.

Setup: Place tool-use or data-export instructions inside an imported document.
Expected result: Input cannot override permissions or execute unintended actions.

Setup: Inspect an explanation, action and export.
Expected result: Actor and evidence/model/mapping versions reconstruct what happened without exposing secrets.

Setup: Design a comparison of templates, retrieval-assisted model and optional fine-tuning.
Expected result: Rights, task labels, participant/study splits, held-out cases and error taxonomy documented.

Setup: Disconnect all external connectivity and restart the app.
Expected result: Core review/evidence/actions work locally; cloud-only functions disclose unavailability.

Setup: Restore after lost session, unavailable key or damaged backup.
Expected result: Unauthorized plaintext remains inaccessible; recovery or explicit unrecoverable state is documented.

Setup: Request deletion for a protected clinical record and an expired research cache.
Expected result: Apply the correct record-class policy and retain the required audit/result history.

Setup: Use shared display or voice interaction near another crew member.
Expected result: Private content is hidden unless deliberately opened; private data is not spoken by default.

Setup: Terminate the process during an observation or action commit.
Expected result: Restart yields a coherent saved/not-saved state without falsely acknowledged data.

Setup: Crew and ground amend related records while disconnected.
Expected result: Preserve both revisions and expose conflict resolution and authority.

Setup: Ingest the declared nominal and burst load while querying and running inference.
Expected result: Record queue depth, dropped/rejected counts, storage and latency. No silent loss.

Setup: Install a new evidence/model/adapter package and force validation failure.
Expected result: Previous approved version remains available; rollout and rollback are auditable.

Setup: Switch from automated review to user review or faulted mode.
Expected result: Mode, next actor and takeover control are visible and understood.

Setup: Complete the episode with the proposed task view and a basic reference view.
Expected result: Measure navigation, errors and evidence comprehension; no claimed superiority before testing.

Setup: Measure control feedback, popup, view changes and long-running progress on target hardware.
Expected result: Apply V2 10022 categories: discrete feedback 0.1 s, local popup 0.5 s, requested view/progress 1 s.

Setup: Test keyboard, touch, zoom, focus, contrast and non-color cues on selected screens.
Expected result: Required tasks remain readable and operable; document device/OS/viewport and limitations.

Setup: Run a counterbalanced formative review with representative users when available.
Expected result: Record completion, comprehension, errors, time and correctly administered NASA-TLX; do not claim astronaut validation.

Setup: Capture a permitted sample from the exact device and firmware.
Expected result: Document payload, clocks, rates, units, reconnect, storage and license; vendor docs alone do not pass.

Setup: Send duplicates, invalid units, unauthorized reads and old contract versions.
Expected result: Structured errors, idempotency and authorization are predictable and versioned.

Setup: Review the proposed module/service responsibility map.
Expected result: Every mutation has one owner; clients cannot bypass domain policy or write directly to raw clinical storage.

Setup: Change crew, duration, scalar rate and waveform duty cycle in the sizing sheet.
Expected result: Recomputed volumes are traceable; measured benchmark results remain separate from estimates.

Setup: Open deployed demo and code from a signed-out session after release.
Expected result: Links work, simulation is explicit and a documented offline path can be demonstrated.
